breedScience.title: AI-Based Breed Improvement + Selective Breeding
process: Local breed cow + BLRI/DLS verified semen (Artificial Insemination)

Next-gen sire selection from proven bulls
breedScience.note: Genetic engineering / lab gene editing terms are NOT used publicly. Institutional partnership with BLRI/DLS only.

subProjects.name: 1. জাত উন্নয়ন (Breed Improvement)
subProjects.goal: দেশি গাবীর দুগ্ধ ও ওজন বৃদ্ধি করতে AI + selective breeding
subProjects.science: Artificial Insemination (BLRI/DLS verified semen) → F1 → F2 record-based selection
subProjects.capex: CAPEX: 50,000–100,000 BDT (semen + AI kit + record system)
subProjects.timing: Year 0–1: nucleus herd → Year 2–3: F1 expansion → Year 4–5: F2 selection
subProjects.stopRule: No sire record = no crossbreeding; no BLRI/DLS partner = no expansion
subProjects.proof: AI receipt, semen source certificate, calf weight log, milk yield log

subProjects.name: 2. ছাগল Nucleus (Goat-first)
subProjects.goal: Low-capital fast cash flow; goat nucleus test before dairy scale-up
subProjects.science: Black Bengal / Jamunapari cross → fast reproduction (5-month kidding) → meat + hide
subProjects.timing: Year 0: shed + purchase → Year 1: first kidding cycle → Year 2: expansion decision
subProjects.stopRule: No scale-up if kidding rate < 60% or mortality > 15%
subProjects.proof: Purchase receipt, kidding log, weight log, vet visit record

subProjects.name: 3. ঘাস ও সাইলেজ (Fodder & Silage)
subProjects.goal: Year-round green fodder supply; silage cuts feed cost 65–75%
subProjects.science: Napier / Maize → wilting → chop → molasses → airtight 21–30 days → pH 3.8–4.5
subProjects.timing: Year 0: plot prep + planting → Year 1: first silage batch → Year 2: full cycle
subProjects.stopRule: pH < 3.8 or > 4.5 = reject batch; no fodder plot = no silage
subProjects.proof: Soil test, seed receipt, silage pH log, feed cost before/after

subProjects.name: 4. বায়োগ্যাস (6m³, Year 3+)
subProjects.goal: Convert goat + cattle dung to cooking gas + organic fertilizer
subProjects.science: 6m³ fixed-dome digester → CH₄ 55–65% → cooking gas + bio-slurry fertilizer
subProjects.timing: Year 2–3: digester build → Year 3: gas production → Year 4: stable output
subProjects.stopRule: Daily dung < 40 kg = delay; no IDCOL approval = no build
subProjects.proof: IDCOL approval letter, digester photo, gas flame test, slurry usage log

subProjects.name: 5. সোলার এনার্জি (Solar)
subProjects.goal: Self-power dairy cold chain; SREDA net metering cuts grid bill
subProjects.science: 5–10 kWp PV array → MPPT charge controller → battery / grid tie → DC loads + AC inverter
subProjects.timing: Year 1: 5 kWp → Year 2–3: 10 kWp + net metering → Year 4: stable
subProjects.stopRule: Self-use < 4 hrs/day = add battery backup; no SREDA = no export
subProjects.proof: SREDA application, panel invoice, generation log, electricity bill comparison

subProjects.name: 6. কম্পোস্ট / ভার্মিকম্পোস্ট
subProjects.goal: Convert dung + crop residue to organic fertilizer for fodder fields
subProjects.science: Aerobic composting (C:N 25–30:1) → thermophilic phase 55°C → 45–60 days → mature compost
subProjects.timing: Year 0: pit build → Year 1: first batch → Year 2: continuous
subProjects.stopRule: Compost temp < 45°C = pathogen risk; heavy metal fail = stop
subProjects.proof: Temperature log, C:N test, mature compost photo, field application photo

silageScience.title: How Silage Works (Process & Science)
steps: Fresh maize cut → wilting to DM 25–30% (lactic acid bacteria growth window)
Chop 1.5–2.5 cm → bacterial fermentation surface area
Molasses 2–4% added → jump-starts lactic acid bacteria colony
Airtight silo 21–30 days → anaerobic fermentation under pressure
pH 3.8–4.5 achieved → feed spoilage stops; feed cost drops 65–75% year-round

biogasScience.title: Biogas Process: Manure → Gas → Bio-Slurry
biogasScience.process: Anaerobic digestion → CH₄ (55–65%) + CO₂ → cooking fuel / generator gas
outputs: Daily cooking gas for family + staff kitchen
Bio-slurry → organic fertilizer for fodder fields

items.q: What phase is the project currently in?
items.a: Year 0: Verification & Foundation. Land document review, boundary survey planning, soil test arrangements, Zone B ejmali status verification, and drainage survey. No construction until every Year 0 item is complete.

Conservative financial policy: monthly EMI stays within 50% of verified rolling 12-month income. Phase-wise CAPEX, 3 vendor quotes per major purchase, Low/Base/High stress tests, CAPEX freeze if runway < 45 days. Relevant channels: BB agriculture & rural refinance, BB Green Refinance, IDCOL biogas, SREDA net metering, PKSF GREEN, BIFFL.

items.q: What is Zone B and what is allowed there?
items.a: Zone B is 12 decimal non-private/ejmali land under legal verification. Only removable structures are permitted: fodder racks, temporary shade, portable compost, loading area, removable water tank. No concrete or permanent structures.

items.q: How does breed improvement work? Is it genetic engineering?
items.a: No. It is Artificial Insemination-based breed improvement and selective breeding — using only verified semen from DLS/BRAC/ACI/Lal Teer/ST Genetics. Lab-based gene editing/embryo transfer could only ever happen with an institutional partner.

Now: verified animal sourcing & verification (100-point scorecard), AI-based breed improvement consultation, vendor/partner onboarding, and partnership discussions. Next/Later products (breeding stock, dairy, compost, silage, bio-slurry, training) unlock when the relevant phase gates pass.
Pre-scheduled appointments only (Phase 1+). Submit an inquiry via the Contact page. Location: Kutirchar, Bhadraghat, Kamarkhanda, Sirajganj, Bangladesh.
Credibility through transparency. Built for bank officers, government, and investors. Open gaps prove we know what to work on — nothing is hidden.

items.q: How do I apply as a vendor or partner?
items.a: Use the Contact form. Select Vendor/Contractor or Bank/Government/NGO-CSR and describe your qualifications and proposal. The 3-quote policy applies to every major purchase.

No regular hiring at present (Year 0). A Field Operations Coordinator is active on site. Training/internships may open in later phases on a demand-gated basis — select 'Training / Visit / Internship' on the Contact form.

items.q: How are environment and sustainability ensured?
items.a: The circular model is the core: dung → biogas → bio-slurry → organic fertilizer → grass → animal feed. Reduced chemical fertilizer and LPG dependence, solar self-use first, and soil organic matter regeneration.

Because this is char land, verification comes first: level and drainage surveys are mandatory, no blind filling until the drainage outlet is confirmed, and permanent construction only after the soil-test gate. Risks and stop rules are reported in every update.
Only what is needed to respond. Never NID, PIN, bank details, or sensitive documents. See the Privacy page for details.

privacy.heroSubtitle: Kutirchar EcoFarm respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect and how we use and protect it.

sections.title: Hard boundary — never public
sections.body: NID, PIN, bank information, family identity documents, and raw legal documents are never published on the public website or repositories. They are held privately for bank/government due diligence only.

sections.title: What information we collect
sections.body: Only what you voluntarily provide through the Contact form (name, organisation, designation, phone/email, message). We never request or collect NID, PIN, passport numbers, bank accounts, or sensitive identity documents.

sections.title: How we use your information
sections.body: Information you provide is used solely to respond to your specific inquiry. No marketing emails, no selling/sharing with third parties, no automated profiling.

sections.title: Retention and security
sections.body: Inquiry data is retained for up to ~24 months after resolution (longer if legally required). The website uses HTTPS encryption.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: This website does not use cookies for personalized advertising, user tracking, or behavioral profiling. Only cookieless, aggregate analytics (such as Plausible/Umami-style tools) may be used.

sections.title: Third-party sharing
sections.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your information. Sharing happens only at your explicit request, under legal obligation, or to protect legal rights.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask what information we hold, request correction, request deletion (subject to legal limits), and withdraw from future communications. We respond to all data requests within 14 business days.

sections.title: Data breach policy
sections.body: If a data breach is detected, affected individuals will be notified within 3 working days.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For questions about this policy or your data: support@kutircharecofarm.com. Postal address: Kutirchar EcoFarm, Kutirchar, Bhadraghat, Kamarkhanda, Sirajganj, Bangladesh.
